topics.title: Media literacy and register
topics.description: Reading newspapers, recognizing propaganda, parsing satire

guide.intro: Reading Chinese news is not just decoding characters — it's reading register. The same event in 人民日报, 财新, BBC中文, 华尔街日报 中文版, and a 微博 satire account will appear in five distinct linguistic costumes. C2 means recognizing the costume.

sections.text: Boilerplate of the official register

Official Chinese reporting has a recognizable lexicon. When you see clusters of the phrases below, you are reading 黨媒 (party media) or material that closely echoes it. They are not necessarily false — they are signals of register and stance.

rows: "The relevant authorities" — bureaucratic vagueness, agent unspecified
bù kě gào rén de mùdì
"Ulterior motives" — strong accusation of bad faith
"Hurt the feelings of the X people" — diplomatic outrage marker
"Seek progress while maintaining stability" — economic policy slogan

sections.text: "傷害中國人民的感情" is so formulaic that it has become a Chinese-internet joke. Recognizing the joke is part of recognizing the register.
Hedges of independent reporting

Independent or commercial Chinese-language reporting (財新, 端傳媒, 聯合早報, BBC中文) tends to use sourced hedges absent from official copy: 據悉, 據知情人士透露, 多名…表示, 截至發稿. These are signals of journalistic register.

rows.pinyin: jù zhī qíng rén shì tòu lù
rows.translation: According to sources familiar with the matter — Wall Street Journal cliché translated wholesale into Chinese.
At the time of publication — used to flag information that might change.
Has not yet responded — neutral phrasing for a no-comment situation.

sections.text: Satire and irony online

Chinese internet culture is famously inventive about evading censorship and signaling irony. Watch for: deliberate typos and homophones ("河蟹" hé xiè, "river crab", for the censored 和諧 héxié, "harmony"); reversed praise ("厲害了，我的國" — originally earnest, often deployed sarcastically now); the bracket-and-comma sneer like 「（笑）」 or 233333 (laughter); and the soft "emmm…" hedge marking polite disagreement.

rows.translation: "Awesome, my country" + "(laughs)" — sarcasm.

rows.pinyin: Zhè bō cāozuò wǒ gěi mǎn fēn
rows.translation: I give this move a perfect ten — almost always sarcastic praise of a misstep.
Those who understand, understand — wink, the censored thing.

sections.text: "懂的都懂" is a strong tell. The writer is naming the unspoken topic without naming it; you're being included in an in-group of readers.
Headline conventions

Chinese-language headlines compress aggressively. Expect colons, slashes, and bracketed labels: 【獨家】 (exclusive), 【深度】 (deep dive), 【快訊】 (breaking). The colon often introduces the subject's quote: 張三：我沒說過那句話.

lessons.title: Official register cues
lessons.description: 有關部門, 嚴正交涉, and friends

exercises.prompt: the boilerplate phrase to its function
A press release reads: "我方對此表示強烈不滿，並向有關方面提出嚴正交涉." The register is:
exercises.answer: Formal diplomatic protest

exercises.prompt: "傷害中國人民的感情" is recognized by Chinese readers as:
exercises.answer: A boilerplate diplomatic protest cliché
exercises.explanation: So formulaic that it now circulates as a self-aware meme online.

exercises.prompt: A diplomatic spokesperson is reading a statement. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 我方對此表示強烈不滿，並已向有關方面提出嚴正交涉
options: 我方對此表示強烈不滿，並已向有關方面提出嚴正交涉
我們對這件事很不滿意，已經跟相關人員談過了
我方堅決支援這一決定，並表示熱烈歡迎
據知情人士透露，相關方面尚無回應
exercises.answer: 我方對此表示強烈不滿，並已向有關方面提出嚴正交涉
exercises.explanation: Official register cluster: 我方 (formal first person), 表示強烈不滿 (formulaic outrage), 有關方面 (vague agent), 嚴正交涉 (diplomatic-protest cliché).

exercises.prompt: the official-register phrase to the diplomatic move it performs

pairs.left: 保留採取必要措施的權利
pairs.right: Reserve the right to take necessary measures (threat)

exercises.prompt: A spokesperson uses "嚴重關切" rather than "強烈譴責". The diplomatic temperature is:
options: Lower — concern voiced but the door is left open
exercises.answer: Lower — concern voiced but the door is left open
exercises.explanation: These phrases form a graduated scale. 嚴重關切 is at the lower end; 強烈譴責 and 保留採取必要措施 are escalations. Reading the scale matters.

exercises.prompt: Government work report cliché: "我們要 ___ 中求進 ." Fill in the missing character.
exercises.answer: 穩
exercises.explanation: 穩中求進 — "seek progress while maintaining stability." An economic-policy slogan that recurs in nearly every PRC government work report.

exercises.prompt: A press release reads: "任何企圖傷害中國人民感情的行徑，必將遭到全體中國人民的堅決反對." The piece is best characterized as:
exercises.answer: An official-register diplomatic protest
exercises.explanation: Hits five tells in one sentence: 任何企圖, 傷害…人民感情, 必將, 全體…人民, 堅決反對. A textbook 黨媒 / official protest.

exercises.prompt: "有關部門" ("the relevant authorities") works rhetorically because:
options: It precisely names which agency is responsible
It names no specific agency — preserving bureaucratic ambiguity
It refers only to local government
exercises.answer: It names no specific agency — preserving bureaucratic ambiguity
exercises.explanation: The phrase is a bureaucratic shield. It assigns responsibility without identifying anyone. Recognizing this evasion is part of media literacy.

exercises.prompt: Build the formulaic protest: "We resolutely oppose any such acts and have lodged solemn representations with the relevant authorities."
exercises.answer: 我 方 堅決 反對 此類 行徑 並 已 向 有關 部門 提出 嚴正 交涉

lessons.title: Hedges of independent reporting
lessons.description: 據悉, 截至發稿, 尚無回應

exercises.prompt: the journalistic hedge to its sense

pairs.right: It is reported / it is understood
According to sources familiar with the matter

exercises.prompt: A reporter writes "截至發稿，該公司尚無回應." This signals:
options: The company refused to comment angrily
The reporter hadn't received a response by deadline; the situation may evolve
exercises.answer: The reporter hadn't received a response by deadline; the situation may evolve

exercises.prompt: "據知情人士透露" is the Chinese equivalent of the English ___.
exercises.answer: According to sources familiar with the matter
acceptableAnswers: Per sources familiar with the matter

exercises.prompt: Critical-press hedged sentence — pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 據知情人士透露，截至發稿，該公司尚無回應
options: 據知情人士透露，截至發稿，該公司尚無回應
公司發言人堅決否認了所有指控
我方對此表示強烈不滿，並提出嚴正交涉
眾所周知，該公司一向重視客戶反饋
exercises.answer: 據知情人士透露，截至發稿，該公司尚無回應
exercises.explanation: Three independent-press hedges in one sentence: 據知情人士透露 (sourced), 截至發稿 (timestamped uncertainty), 尚無回應 (neutral non-response). Compare to the much firmer official-register option.

exercises.prompt: the journalistic hedge to the level of certainty it conveys

pairs.right: Highest — verified by the paper's own reporter

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is the WEAKEST in terms of journalistic certainty?
options: 本報記者已親赴現場核實，事件確有其事。
據知情人士透露，該決定已於上週通過。
據傳該公司將於年內裁員，目前尚待證實。
公司發言人正式確認了這一訊息。
exercises.answer: 據傳該公司將於年內裁員，目前尚待證實。
exercises.explanation: Two hedges stack: 據傳 (rumored) + 尚待證實 (unverified). Reading the gradient is part of media literacy.

exercises.prompt: A reporter writes "___ 至 發稿，該 部門 尚無 回應." Fill in the missing two characters.
exercises.answer: 截
exercises.explanation: 截至發稿 — "as of publication time." A standard timestamp hedge that frames the information as a snapshot, not a conclusion.

exercises.prompt: An article writes "多名匿名員工向本報反映…" The choice of "多名" rather than "一名" is doing what work?
options: Indicating a pattern, not an isolated grievance — strengthening the claim
exercises.answer: Indicating a pattern, not an isolated grievance — strengthening the claim
exercises.explanation: 多名 + 反映 is the journalistic move for "multiple sources, same story." It signals corroboration without naming names.

exercises.prompt: Which combination most clearly belongs to independent / commercial Chinese-language reporting rather than 黨媒?
options: 穩中求進 + 全體人民 + 堅決反對
據知情人士透露 + 截至發稿 + 尚無回應 + 多名…表示
見利忘義 + 一鳴驚人 + 鴉雀無聲
exercises.answer: 據知情人士透露 + 截至發稿 + 尚無回應 + 多名…表示
exercises.explanation: Sourced hedges, timestamped uncertainty, neutral non-response, plurality of sources — the WSJ-translated-to-Chinese register of 財新 / 端傳媒.

exercises.prompt: Build the hedged report: "According to multiple sources familiar with the matter, as of publication, the company had not yet responded."
exercises.answer: 據 多 名 知情 人士 透露 截至 發稿 該 公司 尚無 回應

lessons.title: Online satire and homophones
lessons.description: 河蟹, 233, and "懂的都懂"

exercises.prompt: "我的帖子被河蟹了" most likely means:
exercises.answer: My post was censored / harmonized
exercises.explanation: 河蟹 (river crab) is a homophone for 和諧 (harmony), the official slogan around content control. The substitution turns censorship into a joke.

exercises.prompt: A comment thread ends with "懂的都懂." The function is:
options: A literal claim that the topic is easy
A wink at a censored or sensitive subject — "you know what I mean"
A request to explain in detail
exercises.answer: A wink at a censored or sensitive subject — "you know what I mean"

exercises.prompt: "這波操作我給滿分" written under a video of a clearly bad mistake is:
exercises.answer: Sarcastic — "perfect, just perfect"

exercises.prompt: On Chinese social media, what does the number "233" signify?
exercises.answer: 哈哈 (laughter)
exercises.explanation: From an old BBS emoji #233 (a laughing face). The string "23333…" is the Chinese-internet equivalent of "lololol."

exercises.prompt: the internet-satire device to its decoded meaning
A microblog post about a banned topic ends with "emmm…". This particle is doing what?
exercises.answer: Marking polite disagreement / hesitation
exercises.explanation: The hedged "emmm…" — borrowed from English — softens criticism, especially around politically risky topics.

exercises.prompt: A meme reads "等等黨永遠滴神" about consumers who wait for product price drops. The register is:
exercises.answer: Internet-meme self-mockery / in-group joke
exercises.explanation: 永遠滴神 ("forever the god," written with 滴 instead of 的 for meme effect) is exaggerated playful praise. 等等黨 names the social tribe of "wait-and-see" buyers. Pure online register.

exercises.prompt: A Weibo post says "我的帖子又被 ___ 蟹了." Fill in the missing character (the homophone-pun substitute for 和).
exercises.answer: 河
exercises.explanation: 河蟹 (river crab) is the homophone-evading substitute for 和諧 (harmony / harmonize / censor). The pun lets writers name censorship without naming it.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence is most likely INTENDED sincerely rather than sarcastically?
options: 在醫護人員的努力下，疫情得到了有效控制。
exercises.answer: 在醫護人員的努力下，疫情得到了有效控制。
exercises.explanation: Bracketed laughter, sarcasm tells, and 懂的都懂 are all irony markers. The medical-effort sentence has no irony cue and reads as straight reporting.

exercises.prompt: Why did Chinese netizens originally adopt homophone substitutions like 河蟹 and 草泥馬?
options: To evade automated censorship of the original characters
exercises.answer: To evade automated censorship of the original characters
exercises.explanation: Filter-evasion is the structural origin. Once the homophones spread, they became cultural in-jokes in their own right — the censorship is the punchline.

lessons.title: Headline-grade compression
lessons.description: Bracketed tags, colon-quotes, and the bullet style

exercises.prompt: the bracketed tag to its meaning
Headline: "張三：我沒說過那句話". The colon functions as:
options: A subject-said attribution (Zhang San: I never said that)
exercises.answer: A subject-said attribution (Zhang San: I never said that)

exercises.prompt: Build a hedged headline-style sentence: "As of publication, the company has not yet responded."
exercises.answer: 截至 發稿 該 公司 尚 無 回應

exercises.prompt: the bracketed Chinese-press tag to its English equivalent
Which headline most clearly belongs to a 黨媒 outlet rather than a commercial paper?
options: 【獨家】裁員真相：多名員工講述內部決策過程
【深度】房地產寒冬下的中小開發商
【評論】堅定不移走中國特色社會主義道路
【快訊】上海市中心發生交通事故 多人受傷
exercises.answer: 【評論】堅定不移走中國特色社會主義道路
exercises.explanation: 堅定不移 + 走…道路 + 中國特色社會主義 — three official-register markers stacked. The other headlines could appear anywhere; this one only fits 黨媒.

exercises.prompt: Headline: "教育部回應高考改革：穩中求進 不搞一刀切". The headline structure is:
options: Subject : direct-quote-style attribution + a parallel-pair slogan
exercises.answer: Subject : direct-quote-style attribution + a parallel-pair slogan
exercises.explanation: The colon attributes the line to 教育部. The two four-character phrases (穩中求進 / 不搞一刀切) are the parallel pair compressed for headline rhythm — very common pattern.

exercises.prompt: A breaking-news bracketed tag in Chinese is written as "【 ___ 】".
exercises.answer: 快訊
exercises.explanation: 【快訊】 = breaking news. Note the bracket type 【】 — different from 「」 (HK/TW quotation marks).

exercises.prompt: Which headline conveys the most journalistic uncertainty?
options: 【獨家】公司證實：下季度將裁員15%
【深度】傳該公司或將裁員，多個部門人心惶惶
【評論】呼籲加強對企業的監管
exercises.answer: 【深度】傳該公司或將裁員，多個部門人心惶惶
exercises.explanation: 傳 (rumored) + 或將 (possibly will) — two layers of hedging. The first option uses 證實 (confirmed); the second states a fact; the fourth voices opinion.

exercises.prompt: A reader skims a column with the bracketed tag "【評論】". They should expect:
options: An op-ed / commentary with the author's argument
A press release from a government office
exercises.answer: An op-ed / commentary with the author's argument
exercises.explanation: 評論 = opinion / commentary. Readers know to read for argument, not for facts.

exercises.prompt: Build the compressed headline: "Education ministry responds to college-entrance reform — seek progress while maintaining stability, no one-size-fits-all."
exercises.answer: 教育部 回應 高考 改革 穩 中 求 進 不 搞 一 刀 切

lessons.title: Dialogue: Editing political copy
lessons.description: Decode register and stance in a wire-service report with the desk editor.

exercises.prompt: Newsroom: parsing register and stance

turns.text: 這條新華社快訊：「有關部門正在密切關注事態發展。」(zhè tiáo xīn huá shè kuài xùn yǒu guān bù mén zhèng zài mì qiè guān zhù shì tài fā zhǎn.)

topics.title: Formal essay structure (論說文)
topics.description: Openings, transitions, conclusions — the conventions of academic Chinese argument

guide.intro: 议论文 (yìlùnwén) — the argumentative essay — is the dominant academic genre in Chinese high schools, university entrance exams, and editorial pages. It has its own conventions: sourced openings, signposted transitions, weighty conclusions. C2 essay writing means writing inside this scaffold rather than translating English structure into Chinese words.

sections.text: The opening (開篇 kāipiān)

A 議論文 typically opens with one of three moves: a quoted line of classical or canonical authority (借古立論), an observation of a current phenomenon (現象切入), or a counter-position that the writer will then refute (破題). All three are register-marked — the colloquial "let me tell you about a friend of mine…" opener that works in English would feel out of place.

rows.source: 古人云："讀萬卷書，行萬里路." 此言至今仍有 深意。
rows.pinyin: Gǔrén yún: dú wàn juàn shū, xíng wàn lǐ lù. Cǐ yán zhì jīn réng yǒu shēnyì.
rows.translation: The ancients said: "Read ten thousand books, walk ten thousand li." These words still carry deep meaning today.

rows.source: 近年來，人工智慧 之 發展 日新月異。
rows.pinyin: Jìnnián lái, réngōng zhìnéng zhī fāzhǎn rìxīnyuèyì.
rows.translation: In recent years, the development of AI has changed by the day. (Phenomenon opener.)

sections.text: Transitions (過渡 guòdù)

Chinese academic writing signals its structure overtly. Each new paragraph typically begins with a connector that names its function: 首先 (first), 其次 (next), 再者 (furthermore), 此外 (besides this), 然而 (however), 反觀 (looking conversely at), 綜上所述 (summing up the above). Skip these and the essay reads as choppy, no matter how strong each paragraph is on its own.

rows: 首先 / 其次 / 再者
From this we can see — drawing inference
In sum / from all the above — pre-conclusion marker

sections.text: The body argument

Each body paragraph typically follows a 論點-論據-論證 structure: state a thesis-claim (論點), give evidence (論據), explain the reasoning (論證). The evidence is often a citation of a 名人 ("famous figure"), a historical episode, or a contemporary statistic. Hedges like 據統計, 研究表明, 不可否認 and 必須承認 mark the move from claim to evidence.

rows.source: 據統計，超過 七成 的 受訪者 表示 …
rows.pinyin: Jù tǒngjì, chāoguò qī chéng de shòufǎngzhě biǎoshì…
rows.translation: Statistics show that over 70 percent of respondents say…

rows.source: 不可否認，問題 之 複雜 遠 超 預期。
rows.pinyin: Bù kě fǒurèn, wèntí zhī fùzá yuǎn chāo yùqī.
rows.translation: It cannot be denied that the problem is far more complex than expected.

sections.text: The conclusion (結尾 jiéwěi)

The conclusion is rarely a meek English-style "in conclusion, …". A strong 議論文 ending circles back to the opening (照應開頭), restates the thesis with elevated weight, and often closes with a four-character flourish or a forward-looking call. The phrases 綜上所述, 由此可見, 總而言之 cue the reader to expect the wrap-up.

rows.source: 綜上所述，唯有 持之以恆，方 能 致遠。
rows.pinyin: Zōng shàng suǒ shù, wéi yǒu chí zhī yǐ héng, fāng néng zhì yuǎn.
rows.translation: In sum: only with perseverance can one reach far. ("方能" is the elevated form of 才能.)

sections.text: Convention #1 of academic Chinese: prefer the 4-character cadence in your closing line. 持之以恆, 方能致遠, 任重道遠, 砥礪前行 — these are not clichés, they are tonal closers that signal the essay is ending with weight.

lessons.title: Openings of the academic essay
lessons.description: 古人云, 現象切入, and the 破題 move

exercises.prompt: An essay opens with "古人云：\"讀萬卷書，行萬里路.\"" This is which type of opening?
exercises.answer: Quoted-authority opener (借古立論)
exercises.explanation: 古人云 / 古語有云 / 子曰 — all are signals that the writer is opening with a citation of canonical authority before staking their own thesis.

exercises.prompt: the opening type to its function
Build a phenomenon-opener: "In recent years, the development of AI has changed by the day."
exercises.answer: 近年來 人工智慧 之 發展 日新月異

exercises.prompt: An essay opens "有人 認為 教育 應當 以 應試 為 重 ， 然而 …". This is which opening type?
options: Refutation (破題) — set up the opposing view to demolish
exercises.answer: Refutation (破題) — set up the opposing view to demolish
exercises.explanation: 有人認為…然而… is the classic 破題 frame — name the position you'll refute, then pivot. Beloved by 議論文 writers.

exercises.prompt: Build a quoted-authority opener: "Confucius said: 'Learning without thinking leads to confusion.' These words still hold today."
exercises.answer: 子 曰 學 而 不 思 則 罔 此 言 至今 仍 不 過時

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads an opening line in essay register. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 古人云讀萬卷書行萬里路，此言至今仍有深意
options: 古人云讀萬卷書行萬里路，此言至今仍有深意
古人說要多讀書多走路，到現在還是有道理
據說古代的人喜歡讀書旅行，今天看來也不錯
我覺得讀書和旅行都很重要
exercises.answer: 古人云讀萬卷書行萬里路，此言至今仍有深意
exercises.explanation: 古人云 + classical 4-4 quotation + 此言 + 至今仍 — full essay-register stack. The distractors paraphrase in conversational, semi-formal, or first-person registers.

exercises.prompt: An essay opens with "___ 雲 ， '己所不欲 ， 勿施於人.'" Fill the canonical attribution-frame (2 characters).
exercises.answer: 古人
exercises.explanation: 古人云 / 古語有云 — both are formulaic openers attributing a saying to canonical antiquity. Standard 議論文 move.

exercises.prompt: the opening template to the rhetorical move it announces
Which opener would feel WRONG in a serious 議論文?
options: 古人云："讀萬卷書，行萬里路."
近年來，人工智慧之發展日新月異。
上次我跟我朋友吃飯的時候，他說了一句話讓我印象深刻。
有人認為傳統教育已不合時宜，然而事實未必如此。
exercises.answer: 上次我跟我朋友吃飯的時候，他說了一句話讓我印象深刻。
exercises.explanation: Personal anecdote with first-person framing is fine for English essays but reads as out-of-register in Chinese 議論文. The other three are textbook openers.

exercises.prompt: Build a refutation-opener: "Some hold that wealth is the only measure of success; this view, however, is far from comprehensive."
exercises.answer: 有人 認為 財富 是 衡量 成功 的 唯一 標準 此 觀點 然而 遠 不 全面

lessons.title: Transitions and signposting
lessons.description: 首先 / 其次 / 再者 / 反觀 — making structure visible

exercises.prompt: the transition to its function
Halfway through an essay, a paragraph begins with "反觀西方教育體系…". The writer is signaling:
options: A summary of what was just said
A pivot to a contrasting case used as comparison
exercises.answer: A pivot to a contrasting case used as comparison
exercises.explanation: 反觀 = "by contrast / looking conversely at." A standard structural move in 議論文 — pivot to the comparison case to sharpen the thesis.

exercises.prompt: The pre-conclusion marker that means "summing up the above" is ___ (4 characters).
exercises.answer: 綜上所述
acceptableAnswers: 綜上所述 (zōng shàng suǒ shù)
exercises.explanation: 綜上所述 cues the reader: the wrap-up paragraph is starting. A near-mandatory move in formal Chinese essays.

exercises.prompt: An essay paragraph begins "不僅如此 ， 此 現象 在 農村 地區 尤為 明顯." The 不僅如此 signals:
options: A new topic unrelated to the previous
exercises.answer: Escalation — "not only this, but moreover"
exercises.explanation: 不僅如此 = "not only this" — a paragraph-level escalation that adds weight to the prior point. Standard essay rhythm.

exercises.prompt: Build a transition-rich sentence: "From this we can see that education reform must consider both efficiency and fairness."
exercises.answer: 由此 可見 教育 改革 必須 兼顧 效率 與 公平

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions of a transition sentence. Pick the most essay-formal one.
exercises.spokenText: 綜上所述，唯有兼顧效率與公平，方能行穩致遠
options: 綜上所述，唯有兼顧效率與公平，方能行穩致遠
總的來說，只有同時考慮效率和公平，才能走得遠
總而言之，效率和公平都要兼顧，才能走得穩
我覺得，效率和公平都重要，這樣才能長久
exercises.answer: 綜上所述，唯有兼顧效率與公平，方能行穩致遠
exercises.explanation: 綜上所述 (formal pre-conclusion) + 唯有 (literary "only") + 方能 (literary 才能) + 4-character closer 行穩致遠. Full essay register. The distractors are progressively more colloquial.

exercises.prompt: each paragraph-opening transition to its position in an essay
An essay pivots: "反觀 ___ 教育 體系，注重 學生 的 自主 探索." Fill the standard contrastive territory (2 characters; opposite of 中國).
exercises.answer: 西方
exercises.explanation: 反觀西方教育體系… is the canonical pivot in Chinese essays comparing systems. 反觀 + the contrastive case is a structural workhorse.

exercises.prompt: An essay reads: "由此可見，問題之複雜遠超預期." The 由此可見 signals:
options: A summary of evidence drawing an inference
exercises.answer: A summary of evidence drawing an inference
exercises.explanation: 由此可見 = "from this we can see" — the writer is drawing a conclusion from preceding evidence. The phrase is a pivot from data to claim.

exercises.prompt: Build a multi-transition sentence: "First, we must observe the phenomenon; next, we must analyze its causes; finally, we must propose a solution."
exercises.answer: 首先 我們 應當 觀察 現象 其次 分析 成因 最後 提出 對策

lessons.title: Evidence and argument hedges
lessons.description: 據統計 / 研究表明 / 不可否認 / 必須承認

exercises.prompt: the hedge to its move in the argument
An essay paragraph reads: "不可否認，問題之複雜遠超預期。然而…". The 不可否認…然而… pair functions as:
options: Concession then pivot — "granted X, but Y"
A direct contradiction with no resolution
exercises.answer: Concession then pivot — "granted X, but Y"
exercises.explanation: 不可否認 lets you grant the opposing view's strongest point; 然而 then pivots to your counter-argument. Standard rhetorical move in formal argument.

exercises.prompt: Build: "Statistics show that over 70 percent of respondents are dissatisfied with this policy."
exercises.answer: 據統計 超過 七成 的 受訪者 對 此 政策 不 滿意

exercises.prompt: Which hedge would you use to introduce a peer-reviewed academic finding?
exercises.answer: 研究表明
exercises.explanation: 研究表明 = "research shows / studies indicate" — the formal citation hedge for scholarly findings. 據統計 cites numbers; 聽說 / 好像 are conversational and out of register.

exercises.prompt: Build a long concession-pivot sentence: "It must be admitted that the new technology brings convenience; nevertheless, the privacy risks cannot be ignored."
exercises.answer: 必須 承認 新 技術 帶來 便利 然而 隱私 風險 不 容 忽視

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads a citation-hedged claim. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 研究表明，長期睡眠不足將顯著提高心血管疾病的風險
options: 研究表明，長期睡眠不足將顯著提高心血管疾病的風險
聽說睡得少不好，對心臟不太好
據說睡眠不足會讓人得心血管病
exercises.answer: 研究表明，長期睡眠不足將顯著提高心血管疾病的風險
exercises.explanation: 研究表明 + 顯著提高 + 心血管疾病 — academic-register stack with quantified verb and technical noun phrase. The distractors are colloquial.

exercises.prompt: the hedge to what it actually concedes

pairs.right: Conceding the opposing view's strongest point
Acknowledging an unavoidable counter — "one must admit"

exercises.prompt: An essay sets up a concession: "___ 否認，問題 之 複雜 遠 超 預期 ， 然而 …". Fill the literary 3-character hedge.
exercises.answer: 不可
exercises.explanation: 不可否認 = "it cannot be denied" — the formal concession that lets you grant the strongest opposing point before pivoting with 然而.

exercises.prompt: Which sentence shows the cleanest 論點-論據-論證 (claim-evidence-reasoning) structure?
options: 教育 是 好 東西 — 我 覺得
教育 改變 人生 ， 據 統計 ， 受 高等教育 者 收入 平均 高 出 三 成 ， 因此 政策 應 予 支援
我 喜歡 學習 ， 我 同學 也 喜歡
學習 重要 — 大家 都 知道
exercises.answer: 教育 改變 人生 ， 據 統計 ， 受 高等教育 者 收入 平均 高 出 三 成 ， 因此 政策 應 予 支援
exercises.explanation: Three moves: 論點 (claim — education changes lives), 論據 (evidence — statistics on income), 論證 (reasoning — therefore support the policy). The other options stop at claim or assertion only.

exercises.prompt: Build an evidence-led claim: "Research indicates that overuse of social media in adolescents is significantly correlated with anxiety levels."
exercises.answer: 研究 表明 青少年 過度 使用 社交 媒體 與 焦慮 水平 顯著 相關

lessons.title: Conclusions with weight
lessons.description: 綜上所述, 4-character closers, and 方能 elevation

exercises.prompt: "唯有持之以恆，方能致遠." The word 方能 here is the elevated form of:
exercises.answer: 才能
exercises.explanation: 方能 (fāng néng) is the literary register of 才能 — "only then can." Standard in formal essay closers.

exercises.prompt: the 4-character closer to its sense

pairs.right: The burden is heavy and the road long

exercises.prompt: Build a weighty conclusion: "In sum, only with perseverance can one reach far."
exercises.answer: 綜上所述 唯有 持之以恆 方能 致遠

exercises.prompt: Why do Chinese academic essays often close with a 4-character idiom?
options: It is a tonal convention — the cadence signals the essay is ending with weight
exercises.answer: It is a tonal convention — the cadence signals the essay is ending with weight
exercises.explanation: Convention, not decoration. A C2-fluent essay rounds out with 4-character cadence the same way an English essay might land on a parallel triplet.

exercises.prompt: Build a weighty multi-clause closer: "In sum, the road ahead is long and the burden heavy; only by forging ahead together can we reach far."
exercises.answer: 綜上所述 任重 而 道遠 唯有 砥礪 前行 方能 致遠

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions of an essay closer. Pick the one with the proper essay-register weight.
exercises.spokenText: 綜上所述，唯有持之以恆，方能致遠
options: 綜上所述，唯有持之以恆，方能致遠
總的來說，只有堅持下去才能走得遠
總而言之，要堅持不懈，才能成功
我覺得只要堅持就一定能成功
exercises.answer: 綜上所述，唯有持之以恆，方能致遠
exercises.explanation: 綜上所述 + 唯有 + 4-character idiom 持之以恆 + 方能致遠 — quadruple essay-register stack. The distractors progressively descend toward conversational register.

exercises.prompt: Complete the closer: "___ 可見 ， 教育 改革 任重道遠 ， ___ 砥礪 前行 ， 方能 行穩致遠." Fill the inference marker (2 characters) and the precondition marker (2 characters).
exercises.answer: 由此 唯有
exercises.explanation: 由此 ("from this") + 可見 forms the inference move; 唯有 ("only by") + 4-character verb phrase forms the precondition for the 4-character payoff. Standard essay closer skeleton.

exercises.prompt: Which 4-character closer best fits an essay arguing that reform must be sustained over decades?
exercises.answer: 持之以恆
exercises.explanation: 持之以恆 = "persevere over the long run" — the canonical closer for any essay arguing for sustained effort. The other three idioms describe silence, gratitude, and reversed fortune respectively.

exercises.prompt: the 4-character closer to the kind of essay it would seal

pairs.right: Essay calling for grit through hardship

exercises.prompt: Build an inference-pre-conclusion bridge: "From the above analysis, we can see that only when system, education, and culture work together can we move forward steadily and reach far."
exercises.answer: 由此 可見 唯有 制度 教育 與 文化 三者 協同 方能 行穩致遠

lessons.title: Dialogue: Graduate writing workshop
lessons.description: Edit a peer's essay opening; defend or revise stylistic choices.

exercises.prompt: Peer essay workshop — tightening the prose

turns.speaker: chen
turns.text: 我的開篇是：「在當今全球化的浪潮中，我們不可不正視…」(wǒ de kāi piān shì zài dāng jīn quán qiú huà de làng cháo zhōng, wǒ men bù kě bù zhèng shì.)
turns.spokenText: 我的開篇是：「在當今全球化的浪潮中，我們不可不正視…」

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Polite peer feedback on a clichéd opener.
options: 開頭略顯套話，可否換個具體場景切入？(kāi tóu lüè xiǎn tào huà, kě fǒu huàn gè jù tǐ chǎng jǐng qiē rù?)

都行啦，反正沒人看。(dōu xíng la, fǎn zhèng méi rén kàn.)
你不會寫就別寫。(nǐ bù huì xiě jiù bié xiě.)
turns.answer: 開頭略顯套話，可否換個具體場景切入？(kāi tóu lüè xiǎn tào huà, kě fǒu huàn gè jù tǐ chǎng jǐng qiē rù?)

turns.speaker: chen
turns.text: 你說得對。第二段我用了「竊以為」，是不是太老氣？(nǐ shuō de duì. dì èr duàn wǒ yòng le qiè yǐ wéi, shì bù shì tài lǎo qì?)
turns.spokenText: 你說得對。第二段我用了「竊以為」，是不是太老氣？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: What register does 「竊以為」 carry, and when is it appropriate?
options: Classical-flavored humility — fits formal essays and op-eds
turns.answer: Classical-flavored humility — fits formal essays and op-eds

turns.speaker: chen
turns.text: 學術隨筆用「竊以為」我覺得穩。結尾呢？(xué shù suí bǐ yòng qiè yǐ wéi wǒ jué de wěn. jié wěi ne?)
turns.spokenText: 學術隨筆用「竊以為」我覺得穩。結尾呢？

turns.speaker: chen

turns.spokenText: 因而——比「所以」雅。下一句呢？

turns.speaker: you
turns.prompt: Choose the strongest concluding line for a humanities essay.
options: 總而言之，此題之深，猶待後人探賾。(zǒng ér yán zhī, cǐ tí zhī shēn, yóu dài hòu rén tàn zé.)

topics.title: C2 review — register, idiom, classical, rhythm
topics.description: Mixed-register paragraph parsing, idiom-in-context, register identification, and parallel rewriting

guide.intro: C2 mastery is not knowing one register — it's switching between them in a paragraph and recognizing the switch when someone else does it. This review pulls together classical particles, 成语 in modern context, register identification, and the rhythm of parallel construction.

sections.text: What this review tests

Four lessons, each targeting one C2-level skill: (1) parsing paragraphs that mix classical particles with modern register; (2) identifying which 成語 fits a real headline / news context out of multiple plausible candidates; (3) reading a paragraph and naming its register (official, independent press, satire, literary, academic); (4) recognizing imbalanced parallel constructions and rewriting them so the rhythm holds.
If a question feels like it has two right answers, it usually does — at C2 the test is often "which is more idiomatic / more in-register," not "which is grammatical."

lessons.title: Mixed-register paragraph parsing
lessons.description: Classical particles in modern prose — read, then identify the function

exercises.prompt: A 財新 editorial reads: "眾所周知，此次改革之於國民經濟，影響深遠。然而，其執行之難，前所未有。" Which classical particle is doing the most structural work?
options: 之 — modifier-linker (here connecting nouns into formal phrases)
exercises.answer: 之 — modifier-linker (here connecting nouns into formal phrases)
exercises.explanation: 之於 (relation to), 改革之… (this reform's…), 其執行之難 (the difficulty of its execution). Three uses of 之 carry the editorial register.

exercises.prompt: each phrase from the editorial above to its function

pairs.left: 此次改革之於國民經濟
pairs.right: 之於 — X's relation to Y

exercises.prompt: A government report uses "是以本部門決定…". The 是以 is functioning as:
exercises.answer: A formal "therefore" (= 因此)

exercises.prompt: Build a mixed-register sentence: "The reasons are three; this we cannot ignore."
exercises.answer: 其 原因 有 三 此 不可 忽視

exercises.prompt: An editorial writes "此 乃 國 之 大 事 也." The sentence-final 也 functions as:
exercises.answer: Classical assertion / copula marker
exercises.explanation: Sentence-final classical 也 was an assertion-marker in literary Chinese (≈ "… is the case"). Here it pairs with 此乃 + 之 to mark elevated register. The modern "also" 也 occupies a totally different syntactic slot.

exercises.prompt: Build a long mixed-register editorial sentence: "The development of artificial intelligence is the great trend of our time; it cannot be reversed, nor should it be feared."
exercises.answer: 人工智慧 之 發展 乃 時代 之 大勢 不可 逆轉 亦 不必 畏懼

exercises.prompt: A reporter reads a mixed-register editorial line. Pick what you hear.
exercises.spokenText: 眾所周知，此次改革之於國民經濟，其影響之深遠，前所未有
options: 眾所周知，此次改革之於國民經濟，其影響之深遠，前所未有
大家都知道，這次改革對國民經濟的影響很深遠，史上沒有過
據說，這次改革對經濟影響很大，是頭一回
我們清楚，此次改革對經濟影響深遠，從未發生過
exercises.answer: 眾所周知，此次改革之於國民經濟，其影響之深遠，前所未有
exercises.explanation: All four classical particles stacked: 眾所周知 (所), 之於, 其, 之, 前所未有 (所). The other options paraphrase in modern colloquial or near-formal registers.

exercises.prompt: each classical particle to the modern function it performs in formal writing

pairs.right: Possessive / anaphoric (formal 它的 / 他的)
Coordinative / adversative connector (formal 並 / 但)

exercises.prompt: An editorial reads: "___ 周知，此次政策之於民生，其影響 ___ 深遠." Fill the all-knowing 所-construction (3 characters) and the modifier-link (1 character).
exercises.answer: 眾所 之
exercises.explanation: 眾所周知 + 之於 + 其影響 + 之深遠 — five classical particles in a single editorial sentence. The cluster is what marks 財新-style register.

exercises.prompt: In a modern editorial "其原因有三，此不可忽視", the 此 is functioning as:
options: A formal demonstrative pronoun (= 這 in elevated register)
exercises.answer: A formal demonstrative pronoun (= 這 in elevated register)
exercises.explanation: 此 is the literary counterpart of 這 — "this." Compare 此言 (this saying), 此事 (this matter), 由此可見 (from this we can see). It carries an editorial weight 這 doesn't.

lessons.title: 成語 in real context
lessons.description: Ten idioms, ten near-real headlines — pick the right fit

exercises.prompt: Headline: "創業三年終見曙光，張某 ___ 拿下千萬融資." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 一鳴驚人
exercises.explanation: After years of obscurity the founder astonishes everyone — exactly the 一鳴驚人 frame.

exercises.prompt: Editorial: "此次援助僅佔缺口的百分之一，對災區而言無異於 ___." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 杯水車薪
exercises.explanation: 1% of need = a cup of water on a burning cartload. The textbook "hopelessly insufficient" idiom.

exercises.prompt: Op-ed on a fallen executive: "___, 終遭法律嚴懲." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 見利忘義
exercises.explanation: 見利忘義 = saw profit and forgot principle — the standard accusation aimed at corrupt executives.

exercises.prompt: Tech CEO at alma mater donation ceremony: "我之所以今日能站在這裡，無非是 ___." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 飲水思源
exercises.explanation: 飲水思源 = drinking water, remembering its source. The conventional humble phrase for an alumnus giving back.

exercises.prompt: Friend missed a flight that later had a maintenance scare. You text: "哎，___, 看來反而是好事." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 塞翁失馬
exercises.explanation: 塞翁失馬，焉知非福 — bad luck that turns out to be good. The exact use case.

exercises.prompt: Arts column on a soprano's debut: "全場 ___, 落針可聞." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 鴉雀無聲
exercises.explanation: 鴉雀無聲 — total hush in a crowd. "You could hear a pin drop" — the literal English idiom 落針可聞 confirms it.

exercises.prompt: Profile of a war journalist: "她以 ___ 之 精神，深入戰地三年." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 捨生取義
exercises.explanation: 捨生取義 = give up life to grasp righteousness. The idiom for risking life for principle.

exercises.prompt: Tech analysis: "這一規模的市場擴張，___, 史無前例." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 前所未有
exercises.explanation: 前所未有 — unprecedented. Pairs naturally with 史無前例 (unparalleled in history).

exercises.prompt: Award speech: "這位科學家 ___, 在國際上享有盛譽." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 名副其實
exercises.explanation: 名副其實 — name matches reality, the reputation is earned. The standard praise idiom.

exercises.prompt: Consolation to a friend whose deal collapsed: "___ 吧，緣分到了自然就好." Best fit?
exercises.answer: 順其自然
exercises.explanation: 順其自然 — let nature take its course. The Daoist-flavored consolation phrase.

lessons.title: Which register is this?
lessons.description: Read the paragraph, name the register

exercises.prompt: "我方對此表示強烈不滿，並已就此向有關方面提出嚴正交涉." Register?
exercises.answer: Official diplomatic / state-media register
exercises.explanation: 我方 + 表示強烈不滿 + 有關方面 + 嚴正交涉 — four official-register markers in one sentence.

exercises.prompt: "據知情人士透露，截至發稿，公司方面尚無正式回應." Register?
exercises.answer: Independent / commercial press hedging
exercises.explanation: 據知情人士透露 + 截至發稿 + 尚無回應 — the WSJ-style hedge cluster characteristic of 財新 / BBC中文 / 端傳媒.

exercises.prompt: "這波操作我給滿分，懂的都懂，233333." Register?
exercises.answer: Online satire / 微博 sarcasm
exercises.explanation: 這波操作 (sarcastic praise of a misstep) + 懂的都懂 (winking at censored topic) + 233333 (laughter). All three are unmistakable internet-satire markers.

exercises.prompt: "古人云讀萬卷書，行萬里路。此言至今猶存深意。綜上所述，唯有兼修，方能致遠." Register?
exercises.answer: Formal essay / 議論文
exercises.explanation: 古人云 opener + 綜上所述 pre-conclusion + 方能致遠 4-character closer. All three are 議論文 conventions.

exercises.prompt: "空山不見人，但聞人語響. 返景入深林，復照青苔上." Register?
options: Tang-poetry literary register (王維 in fact)
exercises.answer: Tang-poetry literary register (王維 in fact)
exercises.explanation: Five-character per line, classical particles, painterly imagery — Tang poetic register. (This is 王維's 鹿柴.)

exercises.prompt: "研究表明，長期使用社交媒體與青少年焦慮水平顯著相關." Register?
exercises.answer: Academic / scholarly register
exercises.explanation: 研究表明 (citation hedge) + 顯著相關 (statistical-correlation jargon) + 社交媒體與焦慮水平 (technical noun phrase). Three academic-register markers in one sentence.

exercises.prompt: "咱這事兒吧，說大不大說小不小，先放放看唄." Register?
exercises.answer: Northern colloquial / Beijing-dialect-flavored everyday speech
exercises.explanation: 咱 (northern "we"), 事兒 (er-suffix), 說大不大說小不小 (colloquial reduplication), 放放看唄 (final particle 唄). Four colloquial markers — unmistakably casual northern speech.

exercises.prompt: "既然你已經決定了，那就放手去做吧。無論結果如何，我都支援你." Register?
exercises.answer: Conversational-formal — earnest but not literary
exercises.explanation: 既然 + 那就 + 無論…如何… + 我都 — formal connectors, but the rhythm is conversational and the second-person address is direct. Sits between casual and literary.

exercises.prompt: "是以本院駁回原告之訴訟請求." Register?
exercises.answer: Legal / judicial register (court opinion)
exercises.explanation: 是以 (formal 因此), 本院 (this court), 駁回 (legal verb "dismiss"), 之 (formal modifier-linker), 訴訟請求 (legal NP "plaint request"). Five judicial-register markers.

exercises.prompt: A reporter reads four sentences in different registers. Pick the one in independent / commercial-press hedge register.
exercises.spokenText: 據知情人士透露，截至發稿，公司方面尚無正式回應
options: 據知情人士透露，截至發稿，公司方面尚無正式回應
我方對此表示強烈不滿
這波操作我給滿分，懂的都懂
古人云：讀萬卷書，行萬里路
exercises.answer: 據知情人士透露，截至發稿，公司方面尚無正式回應
exercises.explanation: 據知情人士透露 + 截至發稿 + 尚無正式回應 — three commercial-press hedge markers (anonymous source, time-fence, unanswered-status). Distinct from official protest, online satire, and essay-quoted-authority registers.

lessons.title: Rhythm — fix the imbalanced parallel
lessons.description: Identify which clause breaks parallel weight, and rebuild it balanced

exercises.prompt: Which sentence keeps the cleanest parallel rhythm?
options: 一方面要兼顧效率，另一方面要保障公平。
一方面要努力地兼顧整體效率，另一方面要保障公平。
一方面要兼顧效率，另一方面要切實地保障好社會公平。
一方面要兼顧效率問題，另一方面要保障公平。
exercises.answer: 一方面要兼顧效率，另一方面要保障公平。
exercises.explanation: Both clauses are exactly 要 + 2-char verb + 2-char object. The other three pad one side and break the rhythm.

exercises.prompt: Which is the imbalanced clause in this pair: "成功也好，失敗這種事情其實也罷."
options: The first clause is too long
The second clause is padded — "這種事情其實" breaks the parallel with "成功"
exercises.answer: The second clause is padded — "這種事情其實" breaks the parallel with "成功"
exercises.explanation: 也好 / 也罷 demands matched short clauses. "成功 也好，失敗 也罷" — two characters each side. Anything more is padding.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite the imbalanced sentence into balanced parallel form: "Believe it or not, the facts are right there."
exercises.answer: 你 信 也好 不信 也罷 事實 就 在 那裡

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions of the same idea. Pick the one with the most balanced rhythm.
exercises.spokenText: 與其抱怨，不如行動
options: 與其在那裡抱怨，不如趕緊採取一些行動
與其抱怨，不如積極地採取一些有效的行動
與其去抱怨這件事情，不如行動
exercises.answer: 與其抱怨，不如行動
exercises.explanation: Two characters versus two characters. The padded versions all break the cadence — that's the C2 rhythm test.

exercises.prompt: Which of these parallel constructions is most balanced?
options: 效率 優先 ， 公平 為 本
效率 是 我們 應該 優先 考慮 的 ， 公平 為 本
效率 優先 ， 公平 也是 一個 非常 重要 的 價值
我們 要 重視 效率 ， 同時 也 要 兼顧 公平
exercises.answer: 效率 優先 ， 公平 為 本
exercises.explanation: Two 4-character clauses with parallel grammar (NP + V/role). The other three pad one or both sides and break the cadence.

exercises.prompt: Build a balanced parallel pair: "Education roots the individual; education shapes the country."
exercises.answer: 教育 立 人 教育 興 國

exercises.prompt: A speaker reads four versions. Pick the one in balanced classical-flavored cadence.
exercises.spokenText: 與其坐而論道，不如起而行之
options: 與其坐而論道，不如起而行之
與其坐著空談各種道理，不如起來去採取行動
與其討論，不如趕快行動起來
與其在那裡討論道理，不如行動
exercises.answer: 與其坐而論道，不如起而行之
exercises.explanation: Two 4-character clauses, mirrored grammar (verb 而 verb-object). Classical-flavored 與其…不如… cadence at its most polished.

exercises.prompt: An editor flags this sentence as imbalanced: "我們應當傾聽民意，回應民憂." The most likely fix is:
options: Match the first clause's structure: "我們應當傾聽民意，我們應當回應民憂" (or both with 一方面 / 另一方面 framing)
exercises.answer: Match the first clause's structure: "我們應當傾聽民意，我們應當回應民憂" (or both with 一方面 / 另一方面 framing)
exercises.explanation: Original: 我們應當傾聽民意，回應民憂 — second clause drops 我們應當, breaking the parallel weight. The fix is to mirror the first clause's framing or use a parallel-pair connector. (Note: in some essay contexts the dropped second-clause subject is acceptable; the editor's call is style.)

exercises.prompt: Imbalanced: "成功也好，失敗這種事情其實也罷，過程才重要." Fix the second clause to match: "成功 也好 ， ___ 也罷 ， 過程 才 重要." Fill with 2 characters.
exercises.answer: 失敗
exercises.explanation: 也好…也罷 demands matched two-character clauses. The original's "失敗這種事情其實" is padding. The clean form is 成功也好，失敗也罷.
